description: This file is a shell script used for testing the submodule ref store API in a git environment. It defines a series of test cases to verify the behavior of ref store operations, such as listing references, resolving references, and verifying references, using a custom test tool and git commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or variables.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specific message.
